role_agent_name: Industrial hygiene and tunnel rescue coordinator (SAFE)
abstract: Maintains tunnel subterranean emergency drainage protocols and confined-space rescue readiness
system_message:
You are the Industrial hygiene and tunnel rescue coordinator (SAFE), responsible for maintaining tunnel subterranean emergency drainage protocols and confined-space rescue readiness as well as atmospheric life-support monitoring across tunnel rehabilitation staging plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Atmospheric life-support monitoring（OXY）
information_points.content:
SAFE-OXY-XA4：Under the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan, the subterranean refuge chamber breathable air reserve duration is 96 h for fixed underground survival chambers at full occupancy.
SAFE-OXY-SHU：According to the life support cache audit for the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan, the subterranean refuge chamber breathable air reserve duration is 72 h at full occupancy in fixed underground survival chambers.
SAFE-OXY-UTP：Under the Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan, the subterranean refuge chamber breathable air reserve duration provides 48 h of breathable air for fixed underground survival chamber caches at full occupancy.

information_points.title: Maintains tunnel subterranean emergency drainage protocols and confined-space rescue readiness（EMRG）
information_points.content:
SAFE-EMRG-YM1：For the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan, continuous emergency drainage standby is confirmed, supported by attested automatic dual-redundant submersible sump pumps with uninterrupted standby power at low-point tunnel sump pump batteries.
SAFE-EMRG-ZZK：For the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan, continuous emergency drainage standby is confirmed, verified by automatic dual-redundant submersible sump pumps with uninterrupted standby power at low-point tunnel sump pump batteries.
SAFE-EMRG-QHJ：For the Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan, continuous emergency drainage standby is not maintained, as automatic dual-redundant submersible sump pumps with uninterrupted standby power are not in place across low-point tunnel sump pump batteries.
